affected_rule: Once displacement from the settled reference exceeds 0.01% of a block side or rotation exceeds 0.01 degrees, the block stays affected. This threshold excludes solver jitter.

figure_frames.note: t=1 combines the original upright stacks with the withdrawn support from t=2. It summarizes the removal action, not a sampled physical instant. Both groups share it. Simplified t=2/t=3 deliberately keep the unsupported blocks suspended. Realistic t=2/t=3 use raw simulation poses without edits.

selection_checks.outcome_note: These checks describe the sampled result. A failed target is retained under the requested fallback rather than forcing any final body pose.
